evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said 'This would only take within the next five to seven minutes of your time. Would that be okay?' but did not use the full framing about a dependable quote, and moved forward without waiting for a clear yes.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Earl Smith), moving day (November 1st), route (storage facility to house at 3408 yellow sage lane in Meo Florida), and approximate size (10x15 storage unit, 3 bedrooms but only furnishing 2) all asked.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moved directly into logistics probing: 'okay, let me just check as well just to prevent duplicate profile' and went straight to details gathering.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer during the call.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised that would require reflection.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (storage unit, then house), floor/stories (3rd floor storage with elevator, 1-story house), rooms (3 bedrooms, furnishing 2), walking distance (20 feet from front, 10 feet to elevator), special considerations (indoor storage with elevator, driveway access, no narrow hallways), box count (asked: 'Do you happen to know how many boxes are we moving?'), access concerns (asked and confirmed no issues).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep did not ask about packing services.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Asked: 'Do you happen to know how many boxes are we moving?' Customer said no, couldn't tell.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full. Rep provided typical range ('a typical ten by fifteen storage unit would normally take five and a half to seven and a half hours') and personalized it to this move (third floor with elevator, 20 minutes away, one story house, 2 movers, one truck). Estimated cost: $1,423 for 5.5–6.5 hours.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Fee transparency: trip fee of $175 disclosed upfront because location is outside free travel zone. Commitment framing: '2.5 hour minimum,' 'prorated into fifteen minute increments,' no hidden fees, clock starts on site.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' and did not pause for customer reaction after pricing.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full. 'We have on time guarantee, so we value your time, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Partial. Mentioned '$2,000 per move that is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items' and framed as 'included on the already weigh' but did not explicitly state 'no deductible, no fine print' language.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: True. Asked 'Is that everything that you need or do you still have other concerns?' and did not repeat previously covered material.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Full. 'Is that everything that you need or do you still have other concerns?' is a genuine check, not a throwaway.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. Rep did not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. 'Would you like our help with your move?' asked plainly with no softening or built-in out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: True. 'We can be able to book her slot as early as 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM wherein there's no deposit required. No recent securing your spot in case if you wanted to reschedule or to cancel, then all you have to do is just simply give us a call at anytime.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (November 1st, 8:30–9:00 AM), crew size (2 movers, 1 truck), addresses (origin and destination). Missing: arrival window fully confirmed (slot given but not window repeated back), phone number not confirmed in closing, notes about mover preference (Benji and David) were recorded but customer concerns summary not left explicitly for crew.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details methodically (storage unit dimensions, floor location, destination square footage, access points, layout) and delivered a clear, anchored estimate with proper fee transparency and commitment framing.
coaching_note: Never asked Section 2's 'What are your biggest concerns?' before launching into probing—this is the rubric's highest-weighted item; also skip 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing and the Section 6 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' catch-all.
